It features bicycle rental and is only 820 feet away from Bos en Lommerplein bus and tram stop, where trams to the city center depart. All of the rooms at XO Hotels Blue Tower include a work desk and coffee and tea facilities A buffet breakfast is served in Restaurant Saffron. Amsterdam Sloterdijk Railway Station is less than 20 minutes’ walk away and the center of Amste
